description: This file contains helper functions for managing tenant selection state using localStorage, including getting, setting, and determining if tenant selection UI should be shown. It is maintained for backward compatibility with a legacy approach.

methods.name: getActiveTenantId()
methods.description: Reads the active tenant ID from localStorage, prioritizing the new key 'activeTenant' and falling back to legacy 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in localStorage under the key 'activeTenant', and removes the legacy key 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: needsTenantSelection(tenants)
methods.description: Determines if the tenant selection UI should be shown by checking if an active tenant is not set and if there are multiple tenants available.
